name: Margaret Thompson
bio: Retired elementary school teacher. Lives alone since husband passed in 2021. Two adult children (one in Seattle, one in Denver). Consistent pension income, modest and predictable spending. Regularly shops at Kroger, CVS, and local restaurants. Attends church weekly and donates monthly to her parish.

name: Robert Chen
bio: Retired aerospace engineer who still does occasional consulting. Active lifestyle - travels frequently, plays golf, dines out often. Higher and more variable spending than typical retiree. Has international transactions from travel. Wife Patricia manages household expenses from a joint account.

name: Dorothy Williams
bio: Retired postal worker. Very fixed routine - same grocery store, same pharmacy, same hair salon every month. Limited technology skills. Grandson James helps with online tasks. Social Security is her primary income. Recently started attending a new community center.

name: Frank Martinez
bio: Retired police officer with a good pension. Generous with family - regularly sends money to grandchildren for birthdays, holidays, and college funds. Active in his community, coaches youth baseball. Wife Maria handles most household shopping. Occasionally buys hunting and fishing gear.

name: Helen Park
bio: Retired librarian. Lives independently. Enjoys reading, gardening, and her book club. Moderate technology comfort - uses email and online banking. One daughter nearby who visits weekly. Moved from a house to a condo in early 2024, so some spending pattern shifts are expected from the move.
